svg.title: Player assessment against historical baselines
svg.desc: Wyscout 2017/18 · Positive values mean lower prediction error; zero means the same MAE as the baseline Model and baseline selected on validation only. Reduction = 100 × (baseline MAE − model MAE) / baseline MAE. Lines: 95% entity-bootstrap intervals conditional on fitted models, unadjusted for multiple comparisons.
